## Summary

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Identify the affected CGP components or documentation.

## Related issue

Link a related issue when applicable. Use `Closes #123` only when this change fully resolves it.

## Validation

List checks and results, including anything unverified. Run `pnpm check` and relevant `pnpm test:e2e` scenarios on Node.js 24 or newer with pnpm 11.25.0.

For implementation changes, include Codex Security scope and results, resolution of validated vulnerabilities, and follow-up review of security fixes. Keep vulnerability details and private evidence in the private reporting channel.

For documentation, check formatting, links, section anchors, and setup instructions. For visual changes, include relevant desktop/mobile and account-state browser checks and screenshots.

## Data and deployment

Describe explicit migrations and local configuration requirements. Hosted configuration and deployment are separate approved work; do not describe local checks as hosted verification.

Keep credentials, private addresses, operator infrastructure, and personal data out of the description and evidence.
